title.narrative: Portfolio Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (PMEL) for International Climate Finance (ICF)

description.narrative: A cross-HMG programme delivered jointly by FCDO, DESNZ and DEFRA, to provide robust monitoring and evaluation evidence to support learning across the ICF portfolio. This will be used to better understand and demonstrate the impact of HMG’s ICF portfolio; to provide evidence to help build support for climate monitoring among governments, civil society and private sector stakeholders; and drive increased effectiveness and efficiency of ICF spend. Examples of this programme’s deliverables include continued development of shared Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), enabling of future results collection, thematic evaluations, and facilitation of learning across ICF programmes in the three departments.
